observations: Photo 0 shows a purple embroidered bedding set with duvet, pillowcases, and bed skirt on a bed
Photo 1 shows the same design in red or dark pink
Photo 2 shows the same design in grey with a mug resting on the duvet
All photos carry a centered watermark reading "POSTED ON JIJI AHMAD"
Photo 2 shows corner text "雅殿 ci dian"
No tags, labels, or brand names are visible on the bedding itself
The seller's message contains only a greeting and no item details

risks.risk: Photos may be stock or borrowed images rather than of the actual item for sale
risks.proof: Photo of the item with a handwritten note showing today's date or the buyer's name
risks.if_unproven: Treat as unverified condition and possible misrepresentation; price as used with no proof of ownership

risks.risk: Size is unknown (single, double, queen, or king)
risks.proof: Photo showing a size label or the item measured next to a known object
risks.if_unproven: Price as the smallest common size

risks.proof: Close-up photo of a fabric label or weave detail

risks.risk: Piece count is unknown (number of pillowcases, whether bed sheet is included)
risks.proof: Photo of all pieces in the set laid out together

risks.risk: Condition is unknown (new or used, stains, tears, fading)
risks.proof: Close-up video or photos of seams, corners, and any flaws
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with visible wear

proof_requests: A photo of the actual bedding set with a handwritten note showing today's date
A clear photo of the size label or dimensions
A photo showing every piece included in the set
A close-up of the fabric and any care or content label
A video or close-up photos showing condition, seams, and any stains or damage
response.reason: The photos show three color variants of an embroidered bedding set but carry a third-party watermark, and no size, material, piece count, or condition is visible, so even a worst-case price cannot be set without knowing which variant and what is included.
